item.title: Today in History: February 21, Figure skater Kristi Yamaguchi wins gold for the US
item.description: Kristi Yamaguchi of the United States won the gold medal in women’s figure skating at the Albertville Winter Olympics; Midori Ito of Japan won the silver, and American Nancy Kerrigan the bronze.

item.title: Colorado Lottery wants to start selling tickets online, but a legislative bill would scratch the plan
item.description: A bipartisan group of Colorado legislators on Friday filed a bill to block online lottery ticket sales even as the Colorado Lottery Commission formulates its plan with the support of Gov. Jared Polis.
